units: Gen. R. s. 39 (expl. נְדֹד, Ps. LV, 9) נ׳ טלטול וכ׳ n’dod means moving about, exile after exile.—2) (sub. ראש) head-shaking; נ׳ עבירה an act at which people shake their heads as being wrong.
<cite ref="Tosefta Yevamot 4:8">Tosef. Yeb. IV, 8</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 50b:3">Pes. 50ᵇ</cite> (Ar. <he>ני׳ לעברה</he>).
